functions.name: log
functions.description: Write a message to the native MyceliumVR log.

functions.name: entityCount
functions.description: Return the number of live native ECS entities.

functions.name: dirtyTransformCount
functions.description: Return the number of live entities with dirty transforms.

functions.name: spawnEntity
functions.description: Create a native ECS entity and return its opaque handle.

functions.name: destroyEntity
functions.description: Destroy a native ECS entity. Returns false for stale or invalid handles.

functions.name: entityIdAt
functions.description: Return the EntityId at a given dense-array index, or null if out of range.

functions.name: setTransform
functions.description: Write a transform directly into native ECS storage.

functions.name: getTransform
functions.description: Return the current transform of an entity as an object {px,py,pz,qx,qy,qz,qw,sx,sy,sz}, or null.

functions.name: acquireTransformBuffer
functions.description: Acquire a Float32Array for bulk transform writes.

functions.name: commitTransformBuffer
functions.description: Apply rows from the acquired transform buffer and return the accepted transform count.

functions.name: setMesh
functions.description: Assign a mesh asset handle to an entity.

functions.name: setMaterial
functions.description: Assign a material asset handle to an entity.

functions.name: setNormalMap
functions.description: Assign a normal map texture path to an entity.

functions.name: spawnScene
functions.description: Load a glTF asset and spawn one entity per (node × primitive), applying each node's world transform. Returns an Array of EntityId numbers.

functions.name: setCamera
functions.description: Set camera position and Euler orientation (yaw/pitch in degrees).

functions.name: getCamera
functions.description: Return current camera state as {px,py,pz,yaw,pitch}, or null if no camera.

functions.name: setAmbientLight
functions.description: Set scene ambient light color and intensity.

functions.name: setDirectionalLight
functions.description: Set scene directional (sun) light direction, color, and intensity.

functions.name: setPointLight
functions.description: Set a point light by index (0–7): position, color, intensity, radius.

functions.name: setSpotLight
functions.description: Set a spot light by index (0–7): position, direction, cone angles, color, intensity, radius.

functions.name: clearPointLights
functions.description: Remove all active point and spot lights from the scene.

functions.name: getSceneLight
functions.description: Return current scene light state as an object, or null if not set.

functions.name: getEntityComponents
functions.description: Return an object with all live component data for an entity: transform, meshRenderer, panel, cullOverride, tags. Returns null for invalid entities.

functions.name: getEntityHierarchy
functions.description: Return an array of all live entities with name, kind, parent, alpha mode, and static flag.

functions.name: setSelectedEntity
functions.description: Set the selected entity by ID, clearing any previous selection. Fires __myceliumSelectionChanged in the overlay.

functions.name: createPanel
functions.description: Attach a WebContent panel definition to an entity.
